title: Maintaining Correct Pipe Slope for Gravity Drainage
description: Maintaining the proper slope on horizontal drainage pipes is critical for reliable wastewater removal. Gravity drainage relies on liquid carrying solid waste smoothly through the pipe network. If the pitch is too shallow, water moves too slowly, leaving heavy solids and grease behind to form stubborn clogs over time. Conversely, an excessive slope allows liquids to flow past solids, stranding dry waste in the pipe. Routine inspections using a torpedo level help ensure long horizontal runs remain properly supported with pipe hangers to prevent sagging, belly formation, and long-term drainage failures.
